item.tib: bdud rtsi rgyun med 'khor ba dong sprugs sgrub sman ma bsgom sangs rgyas kyi gta' ru spel thabs lag len
item.coloph: ces bdud rtsi rgyun med 'khor ba dong sprugs sgrub sman ma bsgom sangs rgyas kyi 'od zer gta' ru spel thabs lag len/ rig 'dzin gong ma'i phyag rgyun 'chug med kho bo mi 'gyur tshe dbang gsang sngags grags pas gzhan phan blo yis bskul te 'phral mar du bkod pa'o//
